benchmark_role: fixed SciFact benchmark split, previously evaluated in v1 and not used for v2 training or model selection

splits.source: original SciFact claims_train.jsonl split by configs/splits/scifact_train_dev_v1.json

v1_scoring.rule: score every retrieved-context prediction against the original claim-level SciFact label; whether top-1 is annotated evidence is a separate diagnostic and does not change the gold label
v1_scoring.schema_note: Week 0 B0 is a historical v1 compatibility reproduction. Later v2 comparisons use the v2 schema and are not silently mixed with this reproduction.

retriever.query_prefix: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:

fewshot_budget.method: conservative upper bound using the five longest corpus abstracts as demonstrations plus the longest corpus abstract as the query evidence

test_policy: Milestone 0 may reproduce B0 on the previously evaluated fixed benchmark. B1-B3 and all trained models must not access it before the frozen benchmark evaluation.
